verdict.rationale: Docs claim Claude Code can debug live web apps, analyze CI failures overnight, and 'verifies it works' after writing fixes (docs-2/17/8), suggesting strong reproduce/root-cause/verify support. However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the verification claim, citing self-inflicted bugs (e.g., replace_all corrupting a constant) and stating 'you absolutely can't trust it to self-verify,' plus reports of degrading output quality and high failure rates on iterative fixes.
